root_cause: RichFeatureEnricher merged rolling-provider fields after source-bound Statcast values. A rolling payload could replace plausible xwOBA, xBA, xSLG, barrel, hard-hit, contact, sample-size, or target-date inputs and the simulator preferred the unproven rich value.
repair: Reject rolling-provider collisions with every source-bound Statcast field, sample_pa, and game_date before enrichment.
Persist per-field source kind, source status, source window end, and source row count.
Persist the common batted-ball denominator, barrel count, hard-hit count, and definition for both effective rates.
Reject value changes, missing lineage, source-lineage mismatch, and count-lineage mismatch at feature persistence and probability consumption.

market_adjudication.reason: The repair blocks unproven overrides and leaves every valid probability unchanged. A rescore cannot establish material improvement and would falsely relabel an integrity repair as a model candidate.

highest_value_next_action: Require fresh source-bound prospective batter rows and certified T-minus-4 starter receipts before freezing any new probability challenger.
